test_case.test_name: Path-trajectory-verified HGX NVQual Test #27 PCIe Retrain interoperability
test_case.purpose: Prove each approved Test #27 retrain follows the specified training trajectory and restores every expected NVIDIA endpoint at required generation/width and functional health without hang, unplanned reboot or disqualifying errors.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #27 retrain package/configuration with compatible firmware/driver
Signed root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU/sibling path and stable identity map
Approved retrain primitive, start/target generation-width, LTSSM/equalization/settle/transient/deadline rules
Signed iteration count/timing, durable atomic retrain ledger and first-fault interlock
Dedicated idle HGX SUT, BMC/console, stable power/cooling and out-of-band recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Export/hash baseline logs, topology, negotiated state and inventories. After point approval run only the pinned Test #27 retrain primitive; per request durably record start state, request, LTSSM/equalization trajectory, settled generation/width, complete NVIDIA identities, driver/GPU readiness, timing and error/health deltas before another retrain. Stop on first anomaly; do not rescan, rebind, reset, reboot, power-cycle or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every configured retrain begins in the approved state, follows the authorized trajectory and settles by deadline at required generation/width with all stable NVIDIA identities and functions healthy, all Test #27 items accepted, and no hang, unplanned reboot/reset or disqualifying new errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until Test #27 manifest, path/primitive/start-target trajectory, iterations and recovery are approved. PASS requires every complete accepted retrain. FAIL on missing/invalid start or path, failed/late/downtrained settle, identity/function loss, hang/reboot, disqualifying error or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; escalation/retry cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact retrain primitive/path, start-target/trajectory acceptance, iterations, ledger/interlock and recovery are signed.
Preserve baseline evidence and validate the target path before any state change.
Use an isolated idle SUT with console and explicit long-run retrain authorization.
Stop without rescan/rebind, reset/reboot/power escalation or retry on first anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved Test #27 manifest/configuration and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver/BMC identities plus complete path/sibling/endpoint/GPU stable-identity topology
First-fault/out-of-band recovery or clean final topology/link/device/host state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At wrong-path effect, missing transition artifact, failed/late/downtrained link, identity/function loss, hang/reboot, disqualifying error or artifact gap, inhibit later retrains and preserve the first event. Do not force rescan/rebind or substitute another reset/power mechanism; follow signed recovery and quarantine if expected topology/health is not restored.
